title: Vlad Dracul
summary: Vlad Dracul (also known as Vlad the Impaler, Vlad Tepes, and Dracula) was an ancient and evil Seeker, and an enemy of the Casterwill family. Due to his reputation for evil and inhuman cruelty, ordinary people figured him to be a monster. With his vampiric Titan, Antedeluvian, Vlad became known as the vampire, Dracula.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
Vlad Dracul was the Prince of Wallachia during the fifteenth century and an inheritor of the dark power of [[the Betrayer]]. {{Source|Lok's Leadership}} A truly evil Seeker, he was a fierce enemy of the [[Casterwill family]]. {{source|Artbook}}Like his father, he was a member of the [[wikipedia:Order of the Dragon|Order of the Dragon]]. Vlad Dracul became known as Vlad the Impaler, or ''Vlad Țepeș'' in Romanian, due to having executed his enemies by having them impaled on sharp wooden stakes. He was even believed to have eaten dinner while watching these grisly spectacles. {{extsource|http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vlad_the_Impaler|Vlad III Dracula}} Before his death, he cast a spell which allowed his Titans to remain invoked for centuries. {{source|The Vampire Loses Its Fangs}}

The [[Huntik Foundation|Huntik]] team under [[Dante Vale]] were later sent to reclaim [[Vlad's Bag of Amulets]] from the [[Castle of Vlad Dracul]]. {{source|The Vampire Loses Its Fangs}} Though initially reclaimed by the Huntik Foundation, the [[Blood Spiral Brotherhood|Blood Spiral]] managed to lay claim to the Amulets. [[Tantras]] was able to claim the power of the powerful [[Heart of Vlad Dracul]], but was foiled by [[Dante Vale]], who had [[Ignatius]] burn up the artifact. {{source|Lok's Leadership}}

sections.wikitext:
Vlad Dracul was a very powerful [[Seeker]] who used many dark [[spells]]. Unbeknownst to Vlad, he was an inheritor of the power of [[the Betrayer]] through the powerful artifact known as the [[Heart of Vlad Dracul]], which resided under his throne in his [[Castle of Vlad Dracul|castle]]. sections.heading: Trivia
sections.wikitext:
* His last name of Dracul means dragon, and Dracula means son of the Dragon, both of which reference the [[wikipedia:Order of the Dragon|Order of the Dragon]].
* The real [[wikipedia:Vlad_the_Impaler|Vlad III Dracula]] was a Romanian nobleman who inspired Bram Stoker's ''Dracula''. Vlad III was also known as Vlad Dracul, Vlad the Impaler, and Vlad Țepeș.

Vlad Dracul (also known as Vlad the Impaler, Vlad Tepes, and Dracula) was an ancient and evil Seeker, and an enemy of the Casterwill family. Due to his reputation for evil and inhuman cruelty, ordinary people figured him to be a monster. With his vampiric Titan, Antedeluvian, Vlad became known as the vampire, Dracula.

History

Vlad Dracul was the Prince of Wallachia during the fifteenth century and an inheritor of the dark power of the Betrayer. [Lok's Leadership] A truly evil Seeker, he was a fierce enemy of the Casterwill family. [Artbook]Like his father, he was a member of the Order of the Dragon. Vlad Dracul became known as Vlad the Impaler, or Vlad Țepeș in Romanian, due to having executed his enemies by having them impaled on sharp wooden stakes. He was even believed to have eaten dinner while watching these grisly spectacles. Before his death, he cast a spell which allowed his Titans to remain invoked for centuries. [The Vampire Loses Its Fangs]

The Huntik team under Dante Vale were later sent to reclaim Vlad's Bag of Amulets from the Castle of Vlad Dracul. [The Vampire Loses Its Fangs] Though initially reclaimed by the Huntik Foundation, the Blood Spiral managed to lay claim to the Amulets. Tantras was able to claim the power of the powerful Heart of Vlad Dracul, but was foiled by Dante Vale, who had Ignatius burn up the artifact. [Lok's Leadership]

Abilities

Vlad Dracul was a very powerful Seeker who used many dark spells. Unbeknownst to Vlad, he was an inheritor of the power of the Betrayer through the powerful artifact known as the Heart of Vlad Dracul, which resided under his throne in his castle. His signature Titan was the vampiric Antedeluvian, although he possessed many more. Vlad managed to place an enchantment which allowed his Titans to remain invoked, and wild, after his death.

Bonded Titans

• Antedeluvian
• Multiple unnamed Titans

Artifacts Used

• Heart of Vlad Dracul

Trivia

• His last name of Dracul means dragon, and Dracula means son of the Dragon, both of which reference the Order of the Dragon.
• The real Vlad III Dracula was a Romanian nobleman who inspired Bram Stoker's Dracula. Vlad III was also known as Vlad Dracul, Vlad the Impaler, and Vlad Țepeș.
